full_judgment: 13. Rahter, the presumption of knowledge shall be attributed to the pre-emptors and he or she must prove that the suit was not barred by limitation. In some cases, it has been found that, the sellers transferred their land either for money to go abroad or to meet other urgent need. Then, after a few months, they come up-with a story that his brother or uncle had sold the property without his/her knowledge, although in maximum cases the property was sold in their presence or with their knowledge. The courts must keep in mind that the purchasers have purchased the land, not the litigation.
